scenes.environment: Ren stands on the lighthouse balcony during twilight with Pippin perched on the iron railing, gazing at the misty ocean horizon.
scenes.visual_prompt: Studio Ghibli style cinematic anime scene, twilight on a dramatic coastal cliff, an elderly lighthouse keeper with soft gray hair wearing a navy knitted sweater standing on the iron balcony of an iconic red-and-white stone lighthouse. A cute scruffy seagull is perched on the railing beside him. The ocean below swirls with deep indigo waves reflecting dusk pastels of soft pink (#FF9A9E), warm orange (#F4A261), and subtle glowing cyan water highlights (#00E5FF). Volumetric sea fog, hand-painted watercolor textures, serene and atmospheric.

scenes.environment: Cozy interior of the lighthouse lantern room at night as Ren inspects the glowing lens while Pippin perches on sea charts.
scenes.visual_prompt: Studio Ghibli style interior background art, warm and cozy lighthouse lantern room at night. Large brass Fresnel lens emitting a soft warm golden light (#FFE082). An elderly man with gentle weathered features carefully inspecting the brass mechanisms. A mischievous scruffy seagull perches atop a pile of worn nautical maps on a wooden workbench. Dark indigo night visible through curved glass windows, atmospheric lighting, detailed hand-drawn anime aesthetic, warm shadows.

scenes.environment: Kairo the majestic bioluminescent humpback whale breaches gently near the dark cliffside base, illuminating the dark ocean waters.

Swirling indigo ocean waves glowing with luminescent tide misting against dark rocks. Dramatic sky transitioning from navy (#0F1B33) to soft dusk pink, rich watercolor detail, magical atmospheric environment.

scenes.environment: A close magical night interaction between Ren in a rowboat and Kairo on the luminous sea surface with Pippin hovering nearby.

The whale has glowing cyan bioluminescent skin patterns casting a soft radiance on the water. A cute scruffy seagull hovers overhead in the atmospheric mist. Soft hand-painted watercolor texture, dramatic contrast between dark slate ocean (#2A4B5A) and vivid glowing accents, magical cinematic anime illustration.

storyboard_panels.composition: Ren stands on the iron balcony along the left frame; Pippin is perched beside him on the railing. The vast, swirling twilight ocean and pastel pink and orange sky fill the center and right background.
storyboard_panels.action: Ren rests his hands gently on the lighthouse railing and gazes out at the horizon while Pippin tilts his head, watching the sea fog roll in.

storyboard_panels.composition: The glowing brass Fresnel lens dominates the upper center frame. Ren is positioned on the right inspecting the brass gears, while Pippin perches atop sea charts on a workbench in the lower left.
storyboard_panels.action: Ren carefully adjusts a gear on the lens mechanism as golden light illuminates his face; Pippin pecks playfully at the edge of a nautical map.

storyboard_panels.composition: The dark cliffside topped with the red-and-white lighthouse anchors the upper right frame. Kairo breaches grandly in the lower left ocean, surrounding the dark sea with vivid cyan bioluminescent light.
storyboard_panels.action: Kairo rises smoothly from the deep indigo waters, casting a radiant cyan glow along the cliff base before arching back down into the ocean.

storyboard_panels.composition: Ren sits in his small rowboat on the left side of the frame; Kairo's glowing bioluminescent head rests near the surface on the right; Pippin glides through the misty mist in the upper frame.
storyboard_panels.action: Ren gently extends his weathered hand toward Kairo's luminous skin while Kairo looks up peacefully and Pippin hovers overhead.
